description: Add power-user and data-management features common to mature productivity apps: recurring-task regeneration on completion, an undo toast for deletions, a light/dark theme toggle, keyboard shortcuts, and JSON data export/import (backup & restore). These build on the schema (FEAT-001) and completion/recurrence data (FEAT-002).
steps: Recurring tasks: when a task with recurrence != 'none' is moved to 'done' (via drag to Done column and via any 'complete' action), set its completedAt, and spawn a new task (new id, status 'todo', completedAt null) with the dueDate advanced by the recurrence interval (daily +1 day, weekly +7 days, monthly +1 month) preserving title/description/color/priority/tags/subtasks(reset done=false)/notes/recurrence. Implement in the status-change path (initSortable onEnd) and factor into a helper so it is reused.

Undo delete: replace immediate permanent deletion (trash drag and deleteTask) with a mechanism that removes the task from the array but keeps it in a `lastDeleted` buffer and shows a toast ('Task deleted - Undo') for ~5 seconds; clicking Undo restores it. Add a reusable showToast(message, actionLabel, actionFn) helper and toast container in index.html + CSS.

Theme toggle: add a light theme. Define light-theme CSS variable overrides (body.light-theme { ... }) for the existing --bg, --text, --glass vars so the whole UI adapts. Add a toggle control in the sidebar footer (or header) that flips body class and persists the choice to localStorage (key 'aether_theme'); apply on load before first render to avoid flash.

Keyboard shortcuts: 'n' opens the new-task modal, 'Escape' closes the modal (verify existing), '/' focuses the board search input (from FEAT-003). Ignore shortcuts while typing in inputs/textareas. Register in setupEventListeners.

Data export/import: add Export (download tasks as JSON file named aether-tasks-backup.json using a Blob + anchor) and Import (file input that reads a JSON file, validates it is an array, runs each through normalizeTask, replaces or merges tasks, then saves+renders). Add controls in the sidebar footer or a small settings area; guard against malformed files with a toast error.
Add CSS for the toast, theme toggle control, and export/import buttons consistent with the theme. Bump the style.css cache-busting query (?v=) in index.html.
acceptance_criteria: Completing (moving to Done) a task whose recurrence is Daily/Weekly/Monthly creates exactly one new todo task with the due date advanced by the correct interval and subtasks reset to undone; the original stays in Done with completedAt set.

Deleting a task (trash drag or delete action) shows an Undo toast; clicking Undo within the window restores the task to its prior state and column; letting it expire leaves it deleted. localStorage reflects the final state.
Toggling the theme switches the entire UI between dark and light, persists across reload, and applies on load without a flash of the wrong theme.
Pressing 'n' opens the modal, 'Escape' closes it, '/' focuses board search; shortcuts do not fire while typing in a field.
Export downloads a JSON array of all tasks; importing that file restores the same tasks (round-trip), and importing a malformed file shows an error toast without corrupting existing data.
`node --check app.js` exits 0 and no console errors during these flows.
verification: Serve with `python3 -m http.server 8000`; verify recurrence regeneration, undo toast (both undo and expire), theme toggle + reload persistence, each keyboard shortcut, and export/import round-trip plus malformed-import handling; confirm no console errors.
findings: Implemented all five sub-features in app.js/index.html/style.css. Recurrence: added advanceDueDate() and buildNextRecurrence() helpers; applyStatusChange() sets completedAt and spawns exactly one new todo occurrence only on the transition INTO done (guards against already-done). Tasks with no dueDate still spawn the next occurrence with an empty dueDate so the recurring definition is not lost (documented in code). Both deletion paths (initSortable trash drag and deleteTask) now route through removeTaskWithUndo(), which stashes the removed task and its list index in a lastDeleted buffer and shows a 5s 'Task deleted / Undo' toast; undoDelete() restores it to its prior index. Added showToast()/hideToast() helper + #toast-container in index.html + CSS. Theme: applyTheme() runs before first render (right after state init) to avoid flash; toggleTheme() flips body.light-theme/dark-theme and persists to localStorage key 'aether_theme'; body.light-theme CSS overrides --bg/--text/--glass vars plus input fills. Keyboard shortcuts registered on document in setupEventListeners: 'n' opens modal, 'Escape' closes modal, '/' focuses #board-search (switches to board view first); ignored while typing in input/textarea/select/contentEditable and when modifier keys held. Export/import: exportTasks() downloads aether-tasks-backup.json via Blob+anchor; importTasksFromFile() validates array, runs normalizeTask on each, replaces tasks, and shows an error toast on malformed JSON without corrupting existing data. Sidebar footer gained theme/export/import controls + hidden file input. Bumped style.css cache-bust to ?v=1.9.0. Verified: `NODE_OPTIONS= node --check app.js` exits 0; page + assets serve 200 via python3 http.server; advanceDueDate math verified (daily/weekly/monthly). No automated tests exist; manual UI flows recommended per verification steps.
